import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import re

NS = {
    'main': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main',
    'rel': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships',
}

path = 'sales_data.xlsx'
with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    print("Files in archive:")
    for n in z.namelist():
        print("  ", n)

    # workbook.xml -> sheet names
    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    print("\nSheets:")
    for sh in wb.findall('main:sheets/main:sheet', NS):
        print("  name=%r sheetId=%s rId=%s" % (sh.get('name'), sh.get('sheetId'), sh.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id')))

    # shared strings
    sst = []
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        for si in root.findall('main:si', NS):
            text = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
            sst.append(text)

    print("\nShared strings count:", len(sst))
    for i, s in enumerate(sst[:60]):
        print(f"  [{i}] {s!r}")

    # first sheet xml
    sheet_xml_name = 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'
    if sheet_xml_name in z.namelist():
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(sheet_xml_name))
        print(f"\n{sheet_xml_name} preview:")
        rows = root.findall('.//main:sheetData/main:row', NS)
        print("rows:", len(rows))
        for row in rows[:8]:
            rnum = row.get('r')
            cells = []
            for c in row.findall('main:c', NS):
                ref = c.get('r')
                t = c.get('t')
                v = c.find('main:v', NS)
                isel = c.find('main:is', NS)
                if v is not None:
                    val = v.text
                    if t == 's':
                        idx = int(val)
                        val = sst[idx] if idx < len(sst) else f"<sst{idx}>"
                elif isel is not None:
                    val = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in isel.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
                else:
                    val = None
                cells.append(f"{ref}={val!r}(t={t})")
            print(f"  row {rnum}: {cells}")

import zipfile
import shutil

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data_tmp.xlsx'

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zin:
    entries = {i.filename: i for i in zin.infolist()}
    data = {n: zin.read(n) for n in zin.namelist()}

sheet = data['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'].decode('utf-8')
styles = data['xl/styles.xml'].decode('utf-8')

def replace_once(s, old, new, label):
    cnt = s.count(old)
    assert cnt == 1, f"expected 1 occurrence of {label}, found {cnt}"
    return s.replace(old, new)

# --- sheet1.xml ---
# 1. extend dimension
sheet = replace_once(sheet, '<dimension ref="A1:G10"/>', '<dimension ref="A1:H10"/>', 'dimension')
# 2. add column H (width 12, matching other numeric columns)
sheet = replace_once(sheet,
    '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/>',
    '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/><col width="12" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/>',
    'cols G')
# 3. header cell H1 (style s=1 like other headers)
sheet = replace_once(sheet,
    '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c></row>',
    '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c><c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin %</t></is></c></row>',
    'header row')
# 4. data rows 2..9: H = G / E (style s=3 -> 0.0% percentage)
for r in range(2, 10):
    sheet = replace_once(sheet,
        f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c></row>',
        f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c><c r="H{r}" s="3"><f>G{r}/E{r}</f><v></v></c></row>',
        f'row {r}')
# 5. TOTAL row: overall margin H10 = G10 / E10
sheet = replace_once(sheet,
    '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c></row>',
    '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c><c r="H10" s="3"><f>G10/E10</f><v></v></c></row>',
    'row 10')

# --- styles.xml ---
# 6. add custom number format 0.0%
styles = replace_once(styles,
    '<numFmts count="0"/>',
    '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%"/></numFmts>',
    'numFmts')
# 7. add cell style index 3 referencing numFmt 164, update count
styles = replace_once(styles,
    '<cellXfs count="3">',
    '<cellXfs count="4">',
    'cellXfs count')
styles = replace_once(styles,
    '<xf numFmtId="0" fontId="1" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/></cellXfs>',
    '<xf numFmtId="0" fontId="1" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/><xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/></cellXfs>',
    'cellXfs entries')

data['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'] = sheet.encode('utf-8')
data['xl/styles.xml'] = styles.encode('utf-8')

with zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for name in zin.namelist():
        zout.writestr(name, data[name])

shutil.move(TMP, SRC)
print("OK: added Profit Margin % column (H) with formulas, 0.0% format")
